name: name
invariant: processPragmasIntoFields constructs an own name property from the optional AMD pragma name; unnamed dependencies legitimately store undefined.
upstream: Make the optional AMD dependency name admit the value already stored by the parser, retaining the own property and all parser reads.

name: sourcesContent
invariant: appendSourceMap performs independent caller-owned sourcesContent getter/index reads; the payload read can return undefined after the earlier string test, and setSourceContent stores that exact payload.
upstream: Admit undefined elements in the internal raw source-map representation; coordinate the local storage and setter parameter owners in sourcemap.ts with partition 33.
reason: Stock build fails at sourcemap.ts:216 after this union alone; partition 33 must also widen its local sourcesContent storage and setSourceContent content parameter. The owning field is truthful but cannot land alone under the green-oracle rule.

name: parameters
invariant: getAllDecoratorsOfClass, getAllDecoratorsOfAccessors and getAllDecoratorsOfMethod explicitly store parameters: undefined when legacy decorators are disabled or parameter decorators are absent, while member decorators keep the result present.
upstream: Allow explicit undefined at the optional parameters owner used by the three existing decorator result literals.

name: hasTrailingNewLine
invariant: addSyntheticLeadingComment and addSyntheticTrailingComment always construct an own hasTrailingNewLine property from their optional boolean argument, legitimately storing undefined.
upstream: Make the optional comment flag admit the optional argument already stored by both synthetic-comment producers.

name: prefix
invariant: createBaseGeneratedIdentifier and createBaseGeneratedPrivateIdentifier unconditionally construct an own prefix property from a string | GeneratedNamePart | undefined parameter; absence is preserved.
upstream: Allow explicit undefined in the readonly optional generated-name prefix without changing either generated-name object.

name: suffix
invariant: Both generated-identifier producers unconditionally construct an own suffix property from their string | undefined parameter; absence is preserved.
upstream: Allow explicit undefined in the readonly optional generated-name suffix without omitting its existing own property.
